## By Morale

Morale is what the MM rolls over to break a foe (2d6, over the number breaks it). Low morale ends fights early; morale 12 never breaks.

**Table B0–3: Creatures by Morale**

| Morale | Creature | Level | Role | Breaks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | [Chicken](B1_Beasts_and_Vermin.md) | 1 | Mook | Wanders off the moment nothing is chasing it, and turns up later somewhere nobody can explain. |
| 2 | [A Kindly One](B2_Folk.md) | 2 | Standard | It never strikes back. |
| 5 | [Harbor Thug](B2_Folk.md) | 1 | Mook | Runs, loudly, the moment whoever they are working for goes down or leaves, and takes the nearest portable cargo along. |
| 5 | [Glassback Cow](B1_Beasts_and_Vermin.md) | 3 | Standard | Stops the instant the distance opens. |
| 6 | [Blade of the Bought](B2_Folk.md) | 2 | Mook | Disengages in good order and walks back to the boundary. |
| 6 | [Glassback Bull](B1_Beasts_and_Vermin.md) | 3 | Boss | Walks, not runs, back to the herd. |
| 7 | [The Lead](B1_Beasts_and_Vermin.md) | 3 | Standard | Withdraws down its own road and takes what is left of the pack with it. |
| 8 | [City Watch Sergeant](B2_Folk.md) | 3 | Standard | Surrenders, or accepts a surrender, at once, and starts the paperwork. |
| 8 | [Sergeant-at-Arms](B2_Folk.md) | 3 | Standard | Surrenders the field the moment the contract is void (payment withdrawn, terms broken by the employer, or the named target gone), says so, and expects to be believed. |
| 9 | [Captain-under-Contract](B2_Folk.md) | 4 | Boss | Calls the withdrawal and means it. |
| 9 | [Veteran Soldier](B2_Folk.md) | 4 | Elite | Withdraws in good order when the fight stops being worth the wound. |
| 12 (fearless) | [Ledgerlice](B1_Beasts_and_Vermin.md) | 1 | Mook | Cannot be routed. |
| 12 (fearless) | [Chalk Hound](B1_Beasts_and_Vermin.md) | 2 | Mook | It does not break; it stops, and stopping is the end of it. |
| 12 (fearless) | [Latchling](B3_The_Made.md) | 2 | Mook | Cannot be frightened. |
| 12 (fearless) | [A Waiting One](B4_What_Remains.md) | 3 | Standard | Never breaks. |
| 12 (fearless) | [Latchman](B3_The_Made.md) | 3 | Elite | Nothing to break. |
| 12 (fearless) | [The Unfinished](B4_What_Remains.md) | 4 | Boss | Never breaks; the work is not finishable, and it will not stop for anything short of the party making it so. |
| 12 (fearless) | [Archive Guardian](B3_The_Made.md) | 5 | Boss | Never breaks; it was not built with any. |
